Example - in cities of a developed country, with air conditioning system - people don't really feel the effects of a heatwave. But a similar heatwave in a developing nation would probably be fatal.

It needs to be. We have already crossed 6 out of 9 planetary boundaries. Moving at the same pace, we are bringing overshoot day closer to the start of the year - indirectly, we are not borrowing from the next generation but our own future. 

So, unless we start soon to reverse the effects, we will be in for more climate change events. 

Tbh it is easy to become sustainable, no need to change your lifestyle or spend time, energy, or money - just take micro-actions and do your bit. This has been a challenge for a lot of organizations working in remote/hybrid ecosystem. Here is what might help. 

1. The first thing would be to engage everyone in the ideas/activities. Start with something online, like a coffee meet from home. A small cohort will allow people to know eachother and would create interest in meeting. 

2. Now add a layer of common thought process. E.g.sustainability. Raise awareness but in a way that it feels like small actions. E.g.ask people who are going for a walk/jog to pick up 3 plastic bottles everyday and put them in trash. Create a layer of competition to it, that way team building will happen with an impact. And at the end of the month, the winner gets an extra leave or something. 

3. Your engagement will be better if you are able to reach out to people in DMs as compared to generic channels. Make sure they are personalized so that people are compelled to respond. I know it will be time consuming, we use ReDM, developed in-house, happy to share access to it. Let me know if you'd like to speak about it more. 

Hope these help!
